items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: Leach out of Chicago, a boy played sax.

ctx.x: Who was in that band with you, in the match band?

George Morris, his trombone, trombone. And Sawyer, Sawyer, Sawyer, he was a drummer. And, let's see, I can't call this boy the Badger player. It's kind of like Wilbur or something, Wilbur or something like that, the way his name was. But he lives in Mobile, but he stayed over in Pensacola. And, myself, about a six piece band. Six piece band, I would have about six pieces. A clarinet player? Well we had saxophone play, had Leach out of Chicago. Leach, that's right. Leach out of Chicago, a boy played sax.
Where was George Morris from? Mobile.
